findings.summary: The admitted answer_value_formats is the descriptor's own mutable dict; it can be changed after admission, unlike data_classes (frozen by C3-14).
ref refuses only Unicode Cc; format characters such as U+200B and U+202E pass.
parse_format admits enum values with surrounding whitespace or an embedded newline, which can never match.
The type-fit check unions types across branches and refuses decimal on a JSON-schema integer; over-refusal only, value_passes still gates every value.
The plan's 4c.4 Files list does not name contracts/data_classes.py.
